flora: Cypress cone (small, woody, globose with shield-shaped peltate scales)
Scaly foliage (close-up of tiny, overlapping scale-like needles tightly pressed to the twig)
Cypress sapling (slender, conical shape with reddish-grey bark)
Bark detail (fibrous, exfoliating in thin vertical strips, grey-brown color)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; tactile textures on the 'shield' scales of the cones; emphasis on the tightly packed scaly needles; clear quadrant separation.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: A single globose woody cone; Top-Right: A spray of scaly foliage; Bottom-Left: A young sapling; Bottom-Right: A high-detail view of the fibrous, exfoliating bark.
visual_logic.ground: Soft blue-grey clay with small mottled red sandstone inclusions.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, even, bright diffused daylight to show the intricate overlapping patterns of the needles.
